notes:
NEW FEATURES
Launch update popup: see a new version and tap Update now directly from the main menu.
What's new: read the new features, fixes and patches before updating, and again after installation.

FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS
Scrollable release notes keep longer changelogs readable.
Later lets you keep playing. Update prompts wait until you leave a flight.
Download progress and installer messages appear inside the popup.
Your existing flight progress and achievements are retained.
